title: Compatibility after freeing a coordinate
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates, let $\rho$ assign each coordinate either no restriction or a fixed sign, and let $i$ be a coordinate and $s\in\{\pm1\}$. If $\rho$ leaves $i$ unrestricted and there is a binary assignment making $T$ true after $i$ is fixed to the state determined by $s$, then there is a binary assignment making $T$ true under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, with distinct literal coordinates
$\rho$ assigns a coordinate restriction to each of the $n$ coordinates
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$T$ is compatible with the restriction obtained by fixing $i$ to the state determined by $s$
